parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm with a normal P-QRS-T sequence. The only ST change is mild concave-upward ST elevation with prominent T waves in V2–V3, which fits a benign early-repolarization/normal variant. There is no convex or tombstone ST elevation, no reciprocal depression and no pathological Q waves, so the image does not support the team's acute STEMI impression. If the clinical picture is concerning, compare with a prior ECG and repeat serially.
